lines.text: Whether you’re exploring your future or figuring out what comes next, this is your starting point — part of your broader Early Career Boost journey.
As you move through this track, each step builds your career foundation.
Check off milestones as you go, and your progress bar always shows where you are and what’s ahead.
You’ll learn by doing — click-through activities, short reflections, and uploads.
You’ll use tools like the Career Mapping Tool to explore different pathways.
And if you ever get stuck, help is one click away in the hashtag questionsupport channel.
A fulfilling career starts with the right mindset.
We’ll help you spot the limiting beliefs holding you back and build a growth mindset instead.
Then you’ll dig into the real questions: What makes a dream job today?
Which skills matter in an AI-driven world?
And how do you actually move — networking, building a résumé, and searching for the right opportunities?
Early on, you’ll write a short but powerful career commitment statement — in your Workbook, or with the AI-Career Commitment tool.
Try both for the practice; it’s up to you.
You’ll submit it as your first step — because career development isn’t about thinking, it’s about doing.
From here, you’ll complete short activities, hit milestones, and build skills that move you toward your goals.
